title: Participatory budget priorities
prompt: A city fellowship team has a small public grant and three options: emergency food support, youth transit passes, and a community tool library. What should be prioritized this cycle, and why?

contributions.body: Emergency food support should go first because the harm of waiting is immediate and easy to measure.
contributions.evidenceText: The shortest delay helps the most vulnerable households first.

contributions.body: Youth transit passes are the strongest bridge option because they improve school access and job access at the same time.
contributions.evidenceText: One line item can relieve several barriers at once.

contributions.body: The tool library has slower payoff, but it spreads value across many residents and reduces future household costs.
contributions.evidenceText: Shared infrastructure compounds when the grant is small.

responses.body: I agree on urgency, but the digest should still surface one longer-term option so the cycle does not collapse into only emergency reasoning.
